The route `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar` is registered in `RegisterRoutes` (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124`), which is itself wired up during server startup at `server/server.go:82`. From the browser request to the stored avatar bytes, the hops are:

`RegisterRoutes` (route registration) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:121`
`serveUserAvatar` (HTTP handler for `/file/users/:identifier/avatar`) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`
`getUserByUsername` (resolves the `:identifier` path param to a user) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
`Store.GetUser` (store-facade method, checks cache then delegates) — `store/user.go:148`
`Store.ListUsers` (store-facade method called by `GetUser` on cache miss) — `store/user.go:136`
`driver.ListUsers` (interface method on `store.Driver`, dispatched to the configured backend) — `store/driver.go:47`
`DB.ListUsers` (concrete SQL query against the `user` table, e.g. SQLite backend) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88`

After the data layer returns the `User` row, `serveUserAvatar` reads `user.AvatarURL` (a data URI stored directly in that row — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:192`), decodes it via `parseDataURI` (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737`), and writes it to the response with `c.Blob` (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:209`).
